entries.body_structure_used: flagship: cover (hero, editorial title+dek), overview (stat row + mini-TOC), capabilities (grouped grid), governance (officer cards), engage (contact + signoff) - per 08_document_doctrine flagship structure
entries.design_rationale: Built at Duke Demayo's direction to (1) extract a shared design-tokens/gssc-tokens.css single source of truth from the quotation master :root so all derivatives inherit rather than re-declare values, and (2) demonstrate a company_profile derivative on that shared layer ahead of a real client-facing version needed next week. Cover kept content-light (kicker+title+dek+3 stat pairs only) specifically to avoid the overflow the kernel already measured in Module 18's reverted budget-3 cover experiment. No new colors/fonts/tracking values introduced - all values sourced from the existing 17-color palette and 03_brand type scale.
